title: Setting span
description: A paragraph or a contiguous range of paragraphs, in reading order, over which the frame of the narration holds: where the text is, when, on which plane, in whose voice, how it is told, under what weather and light, and with how many people around. A producer asks these questions paragraph by paragraph and carries each answer forward until the text changes it; a span ends where any value changes. Every slot is optional and an absent slot means the text does not say. Spans never overlap and need not cover every paragraph.

end.description: Last paragraph, inclusive. Absent: the span is the single paragraph `start`.

frame.description: The slots of a setting, with their support. At least one slot is present. Shared by setting spans and by a scene's `setting`.

enclosure.description: Where the body of the narration is. `interior`: inside a building or room. `exterior`: in the open. `vehicle`: inside or on a vehicle (a coach, a ship, a train). `no_place`: there is no where, as in a letter, a summary of years or a narrator's reflection; this differs from an absent `enclosure`, which means the text does not say.

place.description: Where the narration is: an entity of kind `place`.

vehicle.description: The vehicle's name or a short description, in the book's language. Only when `enclosure` is `vehicle`.

surroundings.description: What lies around the narration: `city`, `nature` or `water`. Only when `enclosure` is `exterior` or `vehicle`.

time_of_day.description: The hour of the narration, in six parts.

date_or_reference.description: The date or time reference as the text gives it, in the book's language: «25 de septiembre», «al día siguiente». Free text, not normalised.

plane.description: Which story the paragraphs tell. `main`: the main story. `memory`: an analepsis, a return to an earlier time of the story. `embedded`: a story told inside the story; `plane_level` then says how deep.

plane_level.description: Depth of an embedded story: 1 is a story inside the main story, 2 a story inside that one. Required when `plane` is `embedded`, forbidden otherwise.

voice.description: Who tells, and in what medium. `outside_narrator`: a narrator who is not a character of the story told. `first_person_life`: a character telling their own life. `character_telling`: a character telling others aloud. `written_text`: a letter, a diary or a telegram. `theatre`: dialogue and directions with no narrator.

mode.description: How it is told. `scene`: action narrated as it happens. `dialogue`: characters' speech. `thought`: a character's thinking. `summary`: much story time told briefly. `description`: a pause, the story does not advance. `document`: a text quoted whole (a letter, a sign, a poem). `address`: the narrator speaking to the reader.

light.description: The light, only when the hour does not already give it: `darkness`, `artificial` (a candle, a lamp, electric light) or `moon`.

company.description: How many people are present: `alone` (one), `two`, `group` (a few) or `crowd` (many).

summary.description: A scene's setting: the frame that holds over the scene, with its own support. The same slots as a setting span, with no id, start, end or visibility (it is shown with its scene).
